headline: Public hearings on projects at Greenwood Avenue, Hale Street, McKay Street, Cliff Street, and Beaver Pond Road.
summary: Main items include a pool at 40 Beaver Pond Road and seawall work at 36 Cliff Street and 385 and 407 Hale Street. The agenda also lists four tree removals, three enforcement matters, and mileage approvals.
items: Certificate of compliance for 31 Foster Street (DEP File #5-1320)
Tree removals at 573 Hale Street, 17 Old Rubbly Road, 0 McKay Street, and 9 Orchard Street
Continued: request to amend order for 12 Greenwood Avenue (DEP File #5-1447), filed by 14 Greenwood Beverly, LLC
Request to amend order for 134 McKay Street (DEP File #5-1398), filed by City of Beverly and Beverly Golf & Tennis
Retaining wall rebuild, driveway and drainage repairs, and seawall repairs at 36 Cliff Street (DEP File #5-1482), filed by Richard and Priscilla Gagne
In-ground pool, spa, patio, retaining wall, fence, and concrete pad at 40 Beaver Pond Road (no DEP file yet), filed by Marc and Lisa Maloney
Replace toe protection, seawall, and revetment at 385 and 407 Hale Street (DEP File #5-1483), filed by Endicott College c/o Rick Gagnon
Continued: deck expansion and ceiling under deck at 58 Middlebury Lane, filed by Daniel Guley
Replace concrete pool skirt at 2 Robin Road, filed by Norman Papazian
Removal of nine trees at 332 and 400 Hale Street, filed by Endicott College c/o Rick Gagnon
Continued enforcement order: 25 Linden Avenue (Leslie Salter)
Continued enforcement order: 17 Yankee Way (Robyn Hylind and Matt Hatfield)
Continued enforcement order: 2 Robin Road (Norman Papazian)
Nomination of Greg Power for open OSRC seat
Expenditure approvals for Conservation Agent and Conservation Field Inspector October mileage
location: Google Meet video call (remote participation only, no physical location)
